reason: On transactions.detail-ach, where the pill lives (the comments state is what a click leaves behind), Tab never reaches it: it follows Mercury receipt in DOM order, and focusing the receipt scrolls the panel to its end, which removes the pill before Tab gets there. The pill only scrolls the drawer to its comments and opens nothing, and Tab into the panel then PageDown brings the comments into view, so the content stays reachable and the 2.1.1 failure is minor.
